title: Quaint Norwegian Lamb Skewers
description: A paleo-friendly Norwegian dish featuring lamb, spinach, and a hint of tadka spice, perfect for a date night dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Thread the lamb cubes onto wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
In a bowl, mix together the tadka spice blend, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Brush the spice mixture onto the lamb skewers
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to 145 degrees Fahrenheit
While the lamb is cooking, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat
Add the spinach to the pan and cook until wilted
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and cook until melted and slightly browned
Serve the lamb skewers on a wooden board, topped with the spinach and feta mixture and garnished with pitted dates
